failures.text: Any house with a lantern burning outside stays dry when the water rises.
failures.why: expected river.repel.lit_beacon as the single reading

failures.text: Rainwater is steered away whenever the bells toll.
failures.why: expected rain.redirect.bell as the single reading

failures.text: No spark can harm a house in this village.
failures.why: expected fire.weaken.always as the single reading

failures.text: Anything planted at midnight rots in the ground.
failures.why: expected grain.weaken.night as the single reading

failures.text: The wolves flee the hearth smoke while fevers fade at open doors.
